_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food, snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption' (a page break) 'while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2010 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food, snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption' (a page break) 'while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2010 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.13x; -12% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.24; conservative 2yr +60%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.0%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.3%/yr (Q2 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.7%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2011-08-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.13x (9.8% downside to Bear $56 / +77.2% upside to Bull $110) | Adj composite 2.80 vs market 1.56: gap +1.24 [UNDERVALUED] | -12% above the EPP floor $70 (18x FY11E $3.91) | Conservative 2-yr case: +60.0% total (+30.0%/yr) | At 15.9x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $82 sits at or below the BASE case; servings +6.0% in Q2 2011, forward revenues +11% (Q2 2011 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
